title: What should you ask first in an M&A case, and which trap should you avoid?
description: The first question to ask in an M&A case, how to structure it, and the trap to avoid.
hook: Mergers and acquisitions cases have a reputation for being technical. In practice, they come down to a handful of plain questions.
body:
The first question to ask

Why does the client want to buy?

How to build your structure

  • Target on its own (its market, performance vs peers, standalone value)
  • Synergies (revenue, cost, minus integration costs)
  • Can we make it work? (funding, integration and culture, regulation)
  • Price (price vs value to us, other targets, build or partner instead)

The trap most people fall into

Ignoring integration risk and the do-nothing option.

For the full tree, with every branch, read the acquisition (M&A) framework.
